files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Granary north and west elevations.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
The granary is located northeast of the other buildings. It is a long rectangular building oriented east-west with a side-gable roof covered with standing seam roofing.

files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Granary south and east elevations.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
There is a central aisle with wide openings in the east and west gable ends.

files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Granary north elevation.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
The structure is wood-frame construction on stone piers to the south and a stone foundation to the north. The granary is approximately 36 feet wide and 90 feet long.
